about_the_game:
Everyone, at least once in their lives, has wanted to play a game about eating rats. It comes naturally to EVERY SINGLE ONE OF US.
Now, you can finally make that dream come true. Your feast is different every time—try new flavors and never get bored.

YOU ARE WHAT YOU EAT

When you eat rats, it’s only natural that you can turn into them. Just like in real life. 

But here’s the twist to that normal activity:

  • You can switch between different rats in seconds, letting you experience life as a warrior rat in all its glory.

  • Defeating enemy with diffrent rats allows you to gain diffrent upgrades.

  • You can customise every rat with upgrades. From now ranged rat can turn into stun machine

LET YOURSELF COOK

Explore randomly generated map in search of spices and new rats. 

  • Look for spices that increases your perks rarity

  • Choose between perks

  • Select wich rat to upgrade and decide if you want play as a team or solo rat

TRY FINAL TASTE

Everyone should have some goals.
Some people dont have them but most of us have one goal- eat the RAT KING.
It is no diffrent for US, yeah YOU and ME.
Just imagine the taste...
That's it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Have you ever wanted to play a game about eating rats? Yes, WE ALL dreamed about it— now your childhood dream comes true. Try your luck in this roguelike game where— you won’t believe it... you eat rats. Of course this is realistic game so as in real life when you eat rat you can transform into them
